# +MTOTA URC sequences observed on the bench, copied line for line from the
# transcripts in .superpowers/sdd/2026-09-07-fota-firmware/task-3-report.md
# (sections 5.1 and 5.2, and fix round 1 items 3, 4 and 11) and
# task-4-report.md section 5.1. The two boards produce the SAME sequence:
# the relay is core code and the ports only supply the requestor.
#
# These are the lines, not the brief's expectations, and they differ from
# those in three places worth naming:
#   - every terminal +MTOTA:ERROR,<code> is followed by a closing
#     +MTOTA:IDLE (spec 3.31), which is what puts AT+MTOTA? back to IDLE;
#   - +MTOTA:DOWNLOADED arrives only after the LAST block has been pulled
#     AND acknowledged, not straight after its BLOCK line;
#   - the last progress line is 99, never 100: DOWNLOADED replaces it.
#
# +MTOTABLK payload lines are not reproduced: they are block bytes, and the
# self-tests synthesise their own. Sections are [name]; blank lines and
# lines starting with # are ignored by the reader in test_mt_regression.py.
#
# Timings, for the record (both boards, 115200): the abort lands 5.010 s
# (C6) and 5.009 s (nRF54L15) after the unanswered BLOCK line, against the
# specified 5 s.

# Task 3 report 5.1 / Task 4 report 5.1, run A: two blocks acknowledged,
# then the host goes quiet with block 2 pending.
[abort]
+MTOTA:QUERYING
+MTOTA:AVAILABLE,65541
+MTOTA:DOWNLOADING,0
+MTOTA:BLOCK,0,1024
+MTOTA:DOWNLOADING,12
+MTOTA:BLOCK,1,1024
+MTOTA:DOWNLOADING,24
+MTOTA:BLOCK,2,1024
+MTOTA:ERROR,abort
+MTOTA:IDLE

# Task 3 report 5.2, run B: nine blocks of an 8,274-byte image, every one
# acknowledged. Progress steps by whole blocks over the total, which is the
# Matter header parse working.
[full]
+MTOTA:QUERYING
+MTOTA:AVAILABLE,65541
+MTOTA:DOWNLOADING,0
+MTOTA:BLOCK,0,1024
+MTOTA:DOWNLOADING,12
+MTOTA:BLOCK,1,1024
+MTOTA:DOWNLOADING,24
+MTOTA:BLOCK,2,1024
+MTOTA:DOWNLOADING,37
+MTOTA:BLOCK,3,1024
+MTOTA:DOWNLOADING,49
+MTOTA:BLOCK,4,1024
+MTOTA:DOWNLOADING,61
+MTOTA:BLOCK,5,1024
+MTOTA:DOWNLOADING,74
+MTOTA:BLOCK,6,1024
+MTOTA:DOWNLOADING,86
+MTOTA:BLOCK,7,1024
+MTOTA:DOWNLOADING,99
+MTOTA:BLOCK,8,82
+MTOTA:DOWNLOADED

# Task 3 report fix round 1, item 4: the provider had just been restarted
# and the device's cached CASE session was stale. The requestor reports it,
# returns to idle and retries the same provider on its own, unprompted, and
# the host has to survive that rather than fail on it.
[stale-session]
+MTOTA:QUERYING
+MTOTA:ERROR,session
+MTOTA:IDLE
+MTOTA:QUERYING
+MTOTA:AVAILABLE,65541
+MTOTA:DOWNLOADING,0

# Task 3 report fix round 1, item 11c: AT+MTOTASTAGED=0,1 after a transfer
# that ran to completion. ERROR,cancelled and not ERROR,abort, because a
# completed transfer never reaches the abort path.
[staged-refuse]
+MTOTA:ERROR,cancelled
+MTOTA:IDLE

# Task 3 report 5.2: AT+MTOTASTAGED=1.
[staged-apply]
+MTOTA:APPLY

# Task 3 report fix round 1, items 3 and 11b: AT+MTOTA=2 with the
# DefaultOTAProviders list empty. The shim raises the closing IDLE itself,
# because nothing was started and nothing will come back to idle on its own.
[noprovider]
+MTOTA:ERROR,noprovider
+MTOTA:IDLE
